title: Karatsuba for Gf2mWide N=4 (conditional on bench)
description:
**Conditional** task — one-level Karatsuba for `N=4` only if Task 6 benchmarks show schoolbook is a bottleneck.

## Entry condition

If Task 6's bench shows the scalar schoolbook is already within 2× of handwritten SIMD, **close this task without implementation**. Otherwise:

## Scope

- One-level Karatsuba for `N=4` (3 half-size products instead of 4) in `crates/gf2-core/src/gf2m/wide.rs`. Pure safe Rust over `[u64; 2]` halves.
- Proptest bit-exact equality with `clmul_wide::<4>` on ≥10 000 cases.
- `const fn` compile-time selection between schoolbook and Karatsuba per `N`; no runtime switching.
- Bench delta vs Task 6 baseline recorded in PR body.

## Depends on

Task 6 (bench data).
